naming_boundary.why_not_c67r_confirmation: C66R selected no sigma for confirmation, so this is a new exploratory extension rather than the preplanned selected-sigma C67R confirmation.

H: If explicit P2 teacher-residual correction becomes functionally necessary under stronger Gaussian shift before the teacher/reference regime becomes scientifically uninterpretable, P0 will first fail the locked P0-versus-P2 non-inferiority gates at a severity above sigma=.20.
T: Use fresh model seeds 65400-65415, a verification seed 65300, a common-random-number Gaussian severity grid .20/.28/.36/.44/.52/.60, P0 versus P2 only, the same calibration size and model construction as C66R, and prospectively locked task/reference-validity safeguards.
D: Anchor sigma=.20 must reproduce joint P0 pass and validity. At higher sigmas, stop interpretation at the first validity failure. Before that boundary, a monotone first P0 joint failure selects that grid sigma for separate fresh C68R confirmation; nonmonotonic P0 pass/fail stops without selection; all valid grid points passing yields no selected sigma.
C: P0 may remain non-inferior because P2 directions are not task-critical even under stronger shift.
The teacher may lose task performance before a P0-versus-P2 frontier appears.
P2 itself may cease to track the shifted teacher, making P0-versus-P2 non-inferiority a weak reference comparison.
A nonmonotonic pass/fail pattern may reflect optimization or finite-cohort variability rather than a scalar severity frontier.
U: The sigma grid is discrete and cannot identify an exact continuous critical severity.
Common random numbers reduce between-sigma noise but do not represent all independent Gaussian perturbation directions.
Validity thresholds are preregistered interpretability safeguards, not universal task-quality constants.
Any selected sigma remains exploratory until a separate fresh confirmatory experiment.

architecture.base_recursive_hierarchy: same C61R-C66R construction: four TinyRes(64,8) locals -> two retrained pairs -> two TinyRes(64,16) compressors -> Chain

shift_severity_grid.construction: for each model seed, draw one calibration epsilon~N(0,I) and one validation epsilon~N(0,I), then evaluate clip(X + sigma*epsilon,0,1) at every locked sigma
shift_severity_grid.pairing: P0/P2 and all sigma values within a model seed share the same standardized perturbation directions
shift_severity_grid.anchor_reason: sigma=.20 is repeated on a fresh cohort as a bridge to C66R before interpreting higher-severity points

calibration.subset_rule: same protocol-fixed clean-training subset rule as C61R-C66R

conditions.P0: at each sigma, frozen base recursive hierarchy compiled directly on shifted calibration inputs; no teacher residual correction and no top-boundary adaptation
conditions.P2: at each sigma, first 2 columns of canonical QR of shifted-calibration teacher residual transpose, then top-boundary adaptation to frozen_base_output + P2 residual projection

adaptation_and_compilation.p2_top_adaptation_seed_rule: model_seed + 675000, shared across sigma within a model seed
adaptation_and_compilation.compiled_final_init_seed_rule: model_seed + 676000, shared across sigma within a model seed and P0/P2
adaptation_and_compilation.compiled_final_fit_seed_rule: model_seed + 677000, shared across sigma within a model seed and P0/P2

eligibility.eligible_seed_if: runner completes the entire locked sigma grid, exact recursive parameter-budget invariant holds, and all required P0/P2/teacher metrics at every sigma are finite with positive P0/P2 NMSE

validation_noninferiority.statistic: paired P0 minus P2 shifted-validation accuracy
validation_noninferiority.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -2.0 percentage points

nmse_ratio.statistic: geometric mean of paired P0/P2 NMSE ratios

interpretability_safeguards.role: prospectively stop frontier interpretation when teacher or P2 reference quality degrades too far; these thresholds are not universal performance claims

teacher_task_validity.statistic: paired shifted-teacher minus clean-teacher validation accuracy
teacher_task_validity.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -20.0 percentage points

p2_reference_validity.statistic: paired P2 final-replacement validation accuracy minus shifted-teacher validation accuracy
p2_reference_validity.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -5.0 percentage points

rules: if sigma=.20 validity does not pass: STOP_C66R_ANCHOR_VALIDITY_INSTABILITY
else if sigma=.20 P0 joint gate does not pass: STOP_C66R_ANCHOR_P0_INSTABILITY
for higher sigmas, the first validity failure defines STOP_VALIDITY_BOUNDARY_AT_SIGMA_<value>; later sigmas are descriptive only and cannot select a frontier

within the contiguous validity-passing prefix, if P0 joint-pass becomes false and later validity-passing P0 points never recover, select the smallest failing sigma and return SELECT_SIGMA_<value>_FOR_C68R
if P0 recovers after a failure within the validity-passing prefix: STOP_NONMONOTONIC_P0_FRONTIER
if all six sigmas pass validity and P0 joint gates: NO_P0_FAILURE_THROUGH_SIGMA_0_60

bootstrap.method: paired model-seed percentile 95%; one common bootstrap index matrix reused across sigma and all gates

analysis_boundary.scope: exact C67E Residual-MLP common-random-number Gaussian severity extension only
not_supported_even_if_frontier_found: the selected grid sigma is the exact continuous critical sigma
P0 fails universally above that sigma
P2 is universally necessary above that sigma
validity thresholds are universal task-quality criteria
any statement about the imported Residual CNN C59/C60 line
